requirement.original: 这些都是系统性问题，先修复系统性问题我们再说具体的安排 (systemic shopping image duplication across all brand cards)
requirement.clarified: Stop splitting shopping malls into individual brand cards. Show each shopping location as a single card with its own image, and list brands as sub-items within the card description.
requirement.what: Remove brand-splitting logic in HTML generator; consolidate brands into parent card notes
requirement.why: All brand cards display the same parent mall image because brand-specific images are never fetched, creating a 'default image' appearance across 24 of 25 shopping cards

included: Modify brand-splitting logic (lines 750-777) to produce single card per shopping item
Append brand names/descriptions to card notes_base and notes_local
Clean up mall_name_base/mall_name_local references in JSX template if orphaned
excluded: Fetching individual brand images from Gaode Maps API
Modifying shopping.json or images.json data files
Changing non-shopping sections of the HTML generator

success_criteria: Each shopping location renders as exactly ONE card with its own unique image
All brand information (name, category, description) remains visible within the card
Total shopping cards across all days drops from ~25 to ~10
No adjacent cards show the same image
constraints: Must not lose any brand detail information -- user wants this data visible
Must handle both structured brands array and _parse_shopping_brands() regex fallback
Notes must support both base (English) and local (Chinese) languages

root_cause_analysis.symptom: All brand cards within a mall show the same parent mall photo, appearing as 'default images'
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Brand-splitting logic (lines 750-777) creates individual cards per brand, but images.json has zero brand_* keys. Line 757 falls back to mall_image for every brand card, producing N identical images per mall.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: cfc5766 - fix: realistic prices across all categories + shopping merge bug
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Brand splitting was added as a workaround to surface detailed sub-recommendations within shopping areas
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The image pipeline (fetch-images-batch.py) was never updated to fetch brand-specific images. The brands array contains stall-type shops that often lack distinct Gaode Maps POI images. Result: 24 cards with duplicated images across 9 shopping locations.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Introduced in cfc5766, propagated through all subsequent HTML regenerations

development_approach.strategy: Replace the brand-splitting for-loop with logic that builds a single merged card. Concatenate brand names, categories, and descriptions into notes_base/notes_local. Use the parent mall's image_url directly. Preserve the else branch for items without brands.

scripts/generate-html-interactive.py.lines_750_to_777: Replace brand for-loop with single-card generation that appends formatted brand list to notes
scripts/generate-html-interactive.py.line_2335_area: Review and clean up mall_name_base JSX display logic (may become dead code)

development_approach.validation_approach: Regenerate HTML, count shopping cards per day, verify each has a unique image, confirm brand text appears in card body

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug fix with clear root cause in existing codebase; no architectural patterns to research
